recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Future itemWeight context changes should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack, with FHIR-49329 as the current controlling decision unless the work group reopens the context choice.
issue_request: FHIR-44962 is an Applied FHIR-core change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to make itemWeight easier to use from QuestionnaireResponse answers. The approved resolution was to add QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.value as an allowed itemWeight extension context.
initial_application: The current core checkout has no active StructureDefinition-itemWeight source or fhir.ini itemWeight build entry; it only has examples and narrative links using the extension. The Jira implementation comments cite Git master d979494 and SDCFixes 83a3f61; d979494 was not present in the checked local core or extension-pack histories, while extension-pack commit 83a3f61264e4d1810e5f9a3d00c5c8397fa9e589 added both QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer and QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.value.
additional_context: FHIR-46598 overlapped the same itemWeight context question. Later Published issue FHIR-49329 explicitly resolved the conflict by dropping QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer and leaving QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.value. Zulip discussion and SDC minutes support treating FHIR-49329 as the controlling later cleanup.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the core combined branch. No core source was changed because the authoritative itemWeight StructureDefinition is maintained in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions, where the current source already contains the approved QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.value context and no longer contains the broader QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer context.
source_changes: Empty audit commit only; no core FHIR source files changed.
